scope: Executable architecture of the Resistance Prophet system as it exists on disk, traced from raw assay inputs to served API response fields. Built from an all-refs sweep of 16 on-disk clones (4 distinct remotes), not from guessed paths.

sweep.method: git grep over every ref (local + origin/*) in every clone; hits deduplicated by repo|path
key_negative_results: s3_diag appears in 0 lines of fjkiani/crispro-backend-v2 on every ref. There is no code path from S3 to the served API.
api/services/synthetic_lethality/ovarian.py does not exist in any commit of any clone.
No file in any repository contains a rule of the form s3_diag < 0.10.

nodes.name: obl3_s3_quantification.py
nodes.reproduction_result: exact: AUROC 0.2715, MLE OR/SD 0.0252 p 0.0141, Firth OR/SD 0.0825 p 0.0095, Cox OS HR/SD 0.6869 p 0.043, Schoenfeld 0.2251

nodes.name: s3_diag_cv_validation.json
nodes.problem: Receipt exists; the script that produced it does not. No fold assignments, no OOF prediction file, no seed record beyond the text description.
nodes.reproduction_note: CV AUROC 0.881710 vs documented 0.880723; LOO 0.871648 exact match. Within-fold AUROC of the fitted model equals 1 - AUROC(raw s3) to 1.1e-16 across 1000 folds, so cross-validation adds no information beyond the raw ranking.

self_labels: MISCALIBRATED (over-predicts absolute risk); use rank/threshold not probability
nodes.dead_edge: score_from_cn_features() raises NotImplementedError by design: there is no path from raw CN features to s3 exposure in this repository.

nodes.name: 03_resistance_association.py
nodes.reason: Tests breakpoint-delta, not S3. Requires subject_ledger_FILLED.csv which exists nowhere. Self-gates at MIN_N=40 and MIN_EVENTS=15 per arm and returns tier=discovery_only.

nodes.name: resistance_prophet engine
nodes.evidence_not_fitted: No .fit(), predict_proba, coef_, joblib or pickle anywhere in api/services/resistance_prophet/. compute_probability() in aggregation.py is a hand-weighted confidence x baseline_reliability mean.

nodes.name: PrognosisEngine (s7 rule)
nodes.threshold_source: constants.py:29  SIG7_RISK_THRESHOLD = 0.25  # BriTROC Midpoint (Res=0.333, Sens=0.166). Draft Heuristic.
nodes.namespace_defect: Threshold was derived from Macintyre/BriTROC 7-signature s7; the value is read from COSMIC CN signature CN7. Different frameworks, different definitions. Missing key returns None silently (prognosis.py:67-84).
nodes.qc_defect: prognosis.py:86-101 _check_qc returns True when no QC metrics are found ('lenient for MVP'); bare except also returns True. Fail-open.
nodes.empirical_status_of_the_rule: Measured in this audit as M2a on identical folds: OOF AUROC 0.6446, OOF Brier 0.2090 vs 0.1163 for predicting prevalence. Continuous s7 (M2b) OOF AUROC 0.4108.

duplicated_calculations.verdict: Three representations of one monotone function. The CV'd model's ranking is identical to the raw feature reversed (max deviation 1.1e-16 across 1000 folds), so the three differ only in scaling and in whether a probability is emitted.

Labels agree 134/134 where both are present. britroc_master_published.csv takes the label only from figure_2 and therefore carries NaN for 64 patients, losing 19 resistance labels that figure_1B supplies. Not a labelling conflict; an avoidable join loss.
